title: CBL Reconciler
description: Reconciliation pass freshness and deduplicated discrepancy alerts (CBL-9.4).

panels.title: Recon pass freshness
panels.description: The in-flight window and the age of the last pass per provider.

targets.rawSql: SELECT provider, window_from, window_until, updated_at, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - updated_at)) AS age_seconds FROM recon_runs ORDER BY provider

panels.title: Alerts and occurrences (window)
panels.description: Distinct alert classes and the sum of detection counters.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS alerts, coalesce(sum(occurrences), 0) AS occurrences FROM recon_alert_keys WHERE $__timeFilter(last_seen_at)

SELECT alert_type AS type, count(*) AS alerts, coalesce(sum(occurrences), 0) AS occurrences FROM recon_alert_keys WHERE $__timeFilter(last_seen_at) GROUP BY alert_type ORDER BY occurrences DESC, alert_type
SELECT severity, count(*) AS alerts, coalesce(sum(occurrences), 0) AS occurrences FROM recon_alert_keys WHERE $__timeFilter(last_seen_at) GROUP BY severity ORDER BY occurrences DESC, severity

panels.title: Top merchants (window)
panels.description: System alerts have no merchant and are excluded.

targets.rawSql: SELECT merchant_id, count(*) AS alerts, coalesce(sum(occurrences), 0) AS occurrences FROM recon_alert_keys WHERE $__timeFilter(last_seen_at) AND merchant_id <> '' GROUP BY merchant_id ORDER BY occurrences DESC, merchant_id LIMIT 10

SELECT alert_id, alert_type, ref_id, merchant_id, severity, expected, actual, first_seen_at, last_seen_at, occurrences FROM recon_alert_keys WHERE $__timeFilter(last_seen_at) ORDER BY last_seen_at DESC, alert_id LIMIT 20
